title: Design: Customer chip panel lists All customers and each customer A to Z
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new asset for this test with work orders for two customers.
  • Start on the asset's Work Orders tab.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p7-03-after-customer-chip-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A panel opens under the chip: "All customers" ticked first, a divider, the grey line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then each customer A to Z with a grey dash box.
  • No search box shows (fewer than 9 options).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R2: “A "Customer" filter chip sits beside Status, defaulting to "All customers".”
  • S14-R3: “Its options are every customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z.”
  • S14-R5: “With more than 8 options, the chip offers search ("Search customers").”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "7 Asset Work Orders tab", pictures "Customer chip open" (New, no before exists).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p7-03-after-customer-chip-open.png

The design's own words:

  • “"All customers" ticked, then "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then each customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z”
